comparison_reference.name: Tiny Swords by Pixel Frog
comparison_reference.notes: Named commercial reference; visual comparison is limited to the current candidate and prior review evidence, and the reference pack itself was not directly inspected in this pass.

professional_quality.evidence: The cottage and barn have readable roof forms but repeated shallow slab foundations and regular surface patterning limit architectural finish.
professional_quality.guidance: Compare finish against a named professional reference; explain remaining weaknesses.

readability.evidence: At 1x the teal cottage and red barn are distinct, with recognizable doors and roof silhouettes.
readability.guidance: Identify each subject at native resolution from silhouette and proportions.

pixel_clustering.evidence: At 3x window and roof details form clusters; there are no detached singleton pixels.
pixel_clustering.guidance: Inspect clusters for noise, isolated pixels, banding and accidental geometry.

color_and_lighting.evidence: Warm walls and cooler roofs separate; top roof highlights and darker side walls support depth.
color_and_lighting.guidance: Check palette harmony, volume, light direction and controlled contrast.

materials.evidence: Window glass, timber doors and masonry foundations are distinguished by planes and color, though foundations remain repetitive.
materials.guidance: Explain how each material reads through its structure rather than generic pattern noise.

specialized_design.evidence: The cottage has a chimney and cross gable; the barn has double doors and a gambrel profile.
specialized_design.guidance: Check anatomy, architecture and characteristic features of the subject.

artistic_detail.evidence: Window highlights and shingles add detail, but the long unvaried barn wall and repeated slab foundations remain plain.
artistic_detail.guidance: Assess depth, personality and finish beyond a merely acceptable primitive.

originality.evidence: The cottage and barn use different roof profiles, but the catalog reports exact artwork was previously rejected; metadata additions do not make the artwork new.
originality.guidance: Compare with prior and rejected work; explain new geometry and legitimate reuse.

consistency.evidence: The two buildings share perspective, outline weight, ground treatment and a coherent muted palette.
consistency.guidance: Compare scale, perspective, style and detail density within the intended catalog.

technical_integrity.evidence: The 238 by 120 transparent sheet has two islands, no singleton pixels and at least 7 px of outer margin. Metadata names two buildings and supplies origin, y-sort, collision polygons and entrances.
technical_integrity.guidance: Verify dimensions, transparency, borders, directions and absence of deformation.

game_readiness.evidence: The metadata contains one whole-sheet frame with two attachments; separate extraction and collision alignment, y-sorting and placement in an engine remain untested.
game_readiness.guidance: Verify complete views/states/animations and integration without manual repair.
